verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs name this workflow almost word for word ("Inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge"). Several documented capabilities back it up. Bugbot reviews every PR for bugs, security issues and code-quality problems and can be re-run on demand with `cursor review`. Cloud agents build, test and verify their changes, and they attach screenshots, videos and logs to the PR for validation. Hooks and automations (Security Agents, PR routing) add further pre-merge checks. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the in-editor diff inspection/review UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the review and check flow works as claimed.
